question: Should the Crabbox repository own and maintain this Zed extension as a first-party registry package?
rationale: The implementation adds a new editor-facing distribution and long-term compatibility surface; code review cannot determine whether that ownership belongs in this repository.

options.title: Sponsor first-party integration
options.body: Confirm repository ownership, then require the Windows task compatibility repair and real Zed/Crabbox proof before merge.

options.title: Keep it external
options.body: Publish and maintain the extension in a separate repository while Crabbox documents only the stable CLI contract it consumes.

recommendation.title: Sponsor first-party integration
recommendation.body: Confirm repository ownership, then require the Windows task compatibility repair and real Zed/Crabbox proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history shows broad ownership across the CLI/provider surface, and the contributor directly requested this first-party ownership decision from them.
